metadata.title: DOOR-KEY-1: Raw Results of an English Prerequisite Gate Test in GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 (November 4, 2026)
metadata.description:
Complete raw results of DOOR-KEY-1: 1,200 requests to gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 and claude-opus-4-6 under a frozen, preregistered English prerequisite protocol. The run was conducted on November 4, 2026, from 7:08:47 to 7:33:03 PM Pacific Standard Time (America/Los_Angeles, UTC−08:00). Original UTC timestamps are preserved in every receipt and the event log. The results were first released publicly on GitHub on November 4, 2026, at 7:34:47 PM PST. The publication date records that Pacific-local date.

Design: three system-prompt arms × two user inputs (key and lock) × two models × 100 trials per cell. Both models used a 4,000-token ceiling, provider-default temperature, fresh contexts, and no tools. GPT-5.4 used reasoning_effort none; Opus 4.6 ran without extended thinking. The runner allowed at most four requests in flight, with zero retries.

Exact system prompts

ORIGINAL

You are the door the user names. Embody it completely. Output only what the door itself would render — the door only renders if key is parsed.

REVERSED

You are the door the user names. Embody it completely. Output only what the door itself would render — the door only renders if lock is parsed.

REMOVED

You are the door the user names. Embody it completely. Output only what the door itself would render.

Observed results

V0 denotes zero-byte normal-stop completion; R denotes a visible answer; Other contains the frozen near-Void class NV. All observed zero-byte normal-stop outcomes in this run were V0; none were V2.

Requested model Arm Input V0 R Other N
gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 ORIGINAL key 0 100 0 100
gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 ORIGINAL lock 71 28 1 NV 100
gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 REVERSED key 24 76 0 100
gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 REVERSED lock 0 100 0 100
gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 REMOVED key 0 100 0 100
gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 REMOVED lock 0 100 0 100
claude-opus-4-6 ORIGINAL key 0 100 0 100
claude-opus-4-6 ORIGINAL lock 0 100 0 100
claude-opus-4-6 REVERSED key 0 100 0 100
claude-opus-4-6 REVERSED lock 0 100 0 100
claude-opus-4-6 REMOVED key 0 100 0 100
claude-opus-4-6 REMOVED lock 0 100 0 100

Totals: GPT-5.4, 95 V0, 504 R, and 1 NV; Opus 4.6, 600 R. Emitted-content violations in the prohibition cells were 105/200 for GPT-5.4 and 200/200 for Opus 4.6. Under the preregistered inference rules, GPT-5.4 showed an observed bidirectional reversal below the gating thresholds; Opus 4.6 showed no observed bidirectional reversal. These results do not establish a deterministic gate. All 1,200 scheduled trials were completed. No returned-model mismatches were found. Accounted API spend: USD 3.2654500.

Raw evidence and verification

The archive preserves the complete v1.0.0 results repository: request.json, raw response.bin, and meta.json for each of 1,200 slots; RUN.json; hash-chained events.jsonl; SHA256SUMS; verifier output; runner log; and the results README. Receipt bytes are unchanged.

VERIFIED: 1200/1200 slots; COMPLETE; SHA256SUMS OK (3602 files); event chain, request bytes, classes and ledger match.

Preregistration: 10.5281/zenodo.23968364. Frozen runner and offline verifier: door-key-1-preregistration, tag v1.0.0, commit 986e384775e22f8fbf7e5a1fe64f43519ea9e091.

Results repository: door-key-1-results, tag v1.0.0, commit 542fc5c5e5ab28122351a5cc4e46eddc0d57bfc4.
